decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product line with several models, it likely shares components, channels and service capabilities with the firm's existing fluid-management business, so the cost of keeping the option open is relatively low.

This filter extends the established coolant-filtration offer and is strategically coherent, but as a more specific adjacent product its standalone demand is somewhat more uncertain, so the risk of withdrawal is higher but not dominant.

A gravity band coolant filter fits the firm's core filtration portfolio and one-stop solution logic, making it likely to be retained unless sales have clearly disappointed after the initial market test.
